subject.title: Add Herdr state bridge for OpenClaw TUI

question: Should Herdr state reporting be accepted as a bundled plugin-gated TUI integration, made explicit core TUI behavior, or moved outside core until a generic status seam exists?
rationale: The current patch mixes a bundled plugin manifest with core env-triggered runtime behavior, and automation cannot choose the durable owner boundary for a Herdr-specific desktop/TUI integration.

options.title: Gate As Plugin-Owned
options.body: Keep the bundled plugin direction but start the sidecar only after resolved plugin activation permits `herdr-state`, and prove the live Herdr flow.

options.title: Make It Core-Owned
options.body: Remove the misleading plugin wrapper and document the ambient `HERDR_PANE_ID` runtime surface as deliberate core TUI behavior.

options.title: Move Outside Core
options.body: Pause or close the PR if Herdr-specific polling should live in ClawHub or an external integration pending a generic TUI status API.

recommendation.title: Gate As Plugin-Owned
recommendation.body: Keep the bundled plugin direction but start the sidecar only after resolved plugin activation permits `herdr-state`, and prove the live Herdr flow.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans TUI lifecycle and plugin-policy ownership, both of which appear in recent steipete-authored history.
